set obs 30
set seed 32
gen household_income = (50+(10)*invnormal(runiform()))

ttest household_income, by(dose)
gen double ddose = cond(_n <= 15, 0.1, 0.2)
ttest household_income, by(ddose)
gen big = cond(_n <= 15, 1e10, 2e10)
ttest household_income, by(big)
gen neg = cond(_n <= 15, -1.5, 123456789)
ttest household_income, by(neg)
gen fmt = cond(_n <= 15, 1, 2)
format fmt %9.2f
ttest household_income, by(fmt)
label define partial 1 "one"

clear
set seed 7301
set obs 600
generate byte reg = 1 + floor(runiform()*4)
label define rl 1 "East" 2 "North" 3 "South" 4 "West"
label values reg rl
generate byte female = runiform() < .5
generate byte union = runiform() < .35
generate byte near_college = runiform() < .4
generate double education = 8 + floor(runiform()*10)
generate double exper = floor(runiform()*30)
generate double wage = 2 + .5*education + .1*exper + .02*education*exper + .8*(reg==2) + 1.5*female + 6*(runiform()+runiform()+runiform()-1.5)
generate double years_of_schooling_completed_x = education
generate byte geographic_region_of_residence = reg
label values geographic_region_of_residence rl
generate byte near_college_flag_long_name_xx = near_college
set linesize 80
regress wage i.female#i.reg
regress wage i.reg#i.female
regress wage i.reg##i.female##c.education
logit union i.female#i.reg
regress wage i.near_college
regress wage i.near_college, vce(robust)
regress wage i.near_college, beta
logit union i.female##i.near_college
regress wage c.years_of_schooling_completed_x#c.exper
regress wage i.reg#c.years_of_schooling_completed_x
regress wage c.exper#c.years_of_schooling_completed_x#c.education
regress wage i.female#c.years_of_schooling_completed_x#c.exper
regress wage i.geographic_region_of_residence#c.exper
logit union c.years_of_schooling_completed_x#c.exper
regress wage i.female#i.union#i.reg
set linesize 100
regress wage i.near_college_flag_long_name_xx
logit union i.near_college_flag_long_name_xx
regress wage c.years_of_schooling_completed_x#c.exper
regress wage i.geographic_region_of_residence#c.exper
logit union c.years_of_schooling_completed_x#c.exper
label define reglab 1 "Eastern seaboard and New England states" 2 "Northern plains" 3 "South" 4 "West coast and mountain region"
label values reg reglab
set linesize 80
regress wage i.female#i.reg
regress wage i.reg#i.female
regress wage i.female#i.union#i.reg
regress wage i.female##i.reg
label define fl 1 "woman"
label values female fl
regress wage i.female#i.union
set linesize 200
regress wage i.female#i.reg
regress wage i.union#i.female#i.reg
